title: NPPES Data Extractor — Healthcare Provider Registry Search & Export SaaS
brief: Healthcare outreach and recruitment personnel needed a fast, intuitive application to query the US federal NPPES registry by specialty taxonomy, state, and city, and export matching records to Excel.
approach: Engineered a reactive single-page tool with instantaneous registry searching, multi-parameter filtering, batch extraction algorithms, and automated client-side spreadsheet generation.
outcome: Replaced manual multi-hour data collation with rapid sub-minute automated Excel exports for thousands of provider records.
